channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: A.A.U. Black Site
item.description: As an agent of the secret special forces A.A.U., your covert mission in Serbia goes wrong fast. Framed, intercepted, and stranded in the abandoned territory of Uzovnica, you’ll need every skill to survive, especially when everything around you is not what it seems.

item.title: Berserker Onslaught
item.description: "Berserker Onslaught" is an action roguelike infused with survival and loot-hunting elements. Face relentless waves of monsters, harness the blessings of the gods to strengthen yourself, repel evil forces, and return with bountiful rewards.

item.title: Burden Street Station
item.description: A surreal, narrative adventure game where you shapeshift during conversations to uncover how God went missing.

item.title: Coffee Talk Tokyo
item.description: Coffee Talk Tokyo is the newest entry in the beloved series, set in a late-night café in Tokyo. Brew drinks, meet humans and yōkai, and experience heartfelt stories in a cozy, story-rich world.

item.title: Curse of the Dead Gods
item.description: You seek untold riches, eternal life, divine powers - it leads to this accursed temple, a seemingly-infinite labyrinth of bottomless pits, deadly traps, and monsters.

item.title: Football, Tactics & Glory: World Championship
item.description: Lead a national side, call up the country's best players, and win World and Continental titles! Also includes: player loans, automated transfer search, a third tournament tier, spectator mode, significantly improved club management AI, foreign player limits, extra difficulty options, and more.

item.title: Haydee 2
item.description: Haydee II is a third-person puzzle-shooter, but with a sexy character and a cake!

item.title: House Flipper - Dine Out DLC
item.description: Bring a breath of fresh air into the restaurant business with Dine Out DLC! Renovate a wide variety of establishments such as restaurants, cafes, and sushi bars. Create appealing interiors for sale and for rent, prepare dishes from all around the world and design restaurant signs.

item.title: House Flipper 2 - Sakura DLC
item.description: Travel with us to Japan in House Flipper 2: Sakura DLC! Renovate a tearoom, an onsen, a school… Or use spring- and Japan-themed items to build your own traditional Japanese house, and sell it to one of the new, distinctive buyers!

item.title: JDM: Japanese Drift Master
item.description: Discover Japan’s legendary car culture in JDM! Take on challenging mountain roads, visit Japanese legendary drifting spots in licensed JDM cars and immerse in the story about second chances told through manga pages. Explore an open world where every turn invites you to master the art of drift.

item.title: Luna Abyss
item.description: Luna Abyss is a single player story driven action-adventure with fluid platforming and bullet hell combat. Follow the journey of Fawkes, a prisoner of Luna caught between a cryptic prophecy and their prison sentence.

item.title: Necromunda: Hired Gun
item.description: Become a Hired Gun. The money’s good, the dog’s loyal, and the gun’s reliable. Embark on a fast-paced, violent, and thrilling FPS set in the darkest reaches of Warhammer 40,000’s most infamous hive city.

item.title: PAC-MAN 256
item.description: PAC-MAN 256 is the maze that never ends. But the Glitch is coming for you…

item.title: Plantation Simulator
item.description: Plantation Simulator is a simple farming simulator where you motivate workers to pick your crops! Maintain a beautiful farm by repairing fences to keep workers focused. Choose multiple crops to grow and enhance upgrades to maximize your success!

item.title: Schrodinger's Cat Burglar
item.description: Portal with cats - Become entangled in a quantum puzzle adventure! Mittens gains the incredible power to be in two places at once. Explore twisted test chambers, make mischief and evade capture by a whisker! 🐈🐈‍⬛

item.title: Species: Unknown
item.description: Species: Unknown is a 1 to 4 players co-op survival horror. Complete high-risk missions aboard an abandoned ship while being hunted by an unknown creature. Survive and upgrade your gear to face each new threat that lurks in the dark.

item.title: The House Always Wins
item.description: Build a top-tier business solo or in co-op. Start from scratch, keep the slot machines spinning and deal with chaotic events like vandals and alien invasions. Grow your fortune and show everyone why the house always wins.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide
item.description: Take back the city of Tertium from hordes of bloodthirsty foes in this intense and brutal action shooter. Warhammer 40,000: Darktide is the new co-op focused experience from the award-winning team behind the Vermintide series. As Tertium falls, Rejects Will Rise.

item.title: Warhammer: Vermintide 2
item.description: The critically acclaimed Vermintide 2 is a visually stunning and groundbreaking melee action game pushing the boundaries of the first person co-op genre. Join the fight now!

item.title: ARCADE GAME SERIES: GALAGA
item.description: First appearing in arcades in 1981, the masterpiece GALAGA finally comes to Steam! Move the fighter left and right and destroy the waves of incoming aliens!

item.title: ARCADE GAME SERIES: Ms. PAC-MAN
item.description: Developed in America and first released in 1981, Ms. PAC-MAN finally comes to Steam! Move Ms. PAC-MAN up, down, left, and right to avoid the ghosts and gobble up all the Pac-Dots!

item.title: ARCADE GAME SERIES: PAC-MAN
item.description: First released in arcades in 1980, the masterpiece PAC-MAN comes to Steam! Move PAC-MAN up, down, left, and right to avoid the ghosts and gobble up all the Pac-Dots!

item.title: Biped
item.description: Biped is a coop action adventure game with a strong focus on moment-to-moment collaboration between 2 players.

item.title: Biped 2
item.description: Biped 2 is a coop action adventure game with a strong focus on moment-to-moment collaboration alone or between 2 or 4 players.

item.title: Desktop Nard: Dice Idle
item.description: Idle Dice roll automatically for you, unleashing skills and farming rare loot in the corner of your desktop, with tons of content and loot types.

item.title: Endoparasitic
item.description: Three limbs ripped off, infected with a deadly parasite, you must save your research. Drag yourself through the corridors of a secret research lab on a remote asteroid, fight off horribly mutated monsters, inject countless syringes of vaccines, and survive at all costs.

item.title: Ghost Exile
item.description: Ghost Exile - is a cooperative horror from 1 to 4 players: when hunting for ghosts, you need to determine the type of ghost, carry out a ritual of exorcism and then the ghost can no longer harm anyone. Be careful! Hasty conclusions can lead you to a sad outcome.

item.title: House Flipper 2 - Scooby-Doo DLC
item.description: Pinnacove needs your help! The once peaceful town has become witness to supernatural events. So let's do what you do best, Flipper, clean up the mess! Luckily, you’re not alone. With the help of Scooby, Shaggy and the rest of the Mystery Inc. gang follow the clues and discover an old mystery.

item.title: Lushfoil Photography Sim
item.description: A tranquil exploration and photography experience set across a vast selection of faithfully detailed landscapes.

item.title: PAC-MAN™ CHAMPIONSHIP EDITION 2
item.description: The much-awaited sequel to PAC-MAN™ CHAMPIONSHIP EDITION! Featuring eye-popping 3D graphics and funky visuals! New modes include Score Attack and an Adventure mode!

item.title: Shadow Labyrinth
item.description: Shadow Labyrinth is a 2D action platformer and a genre-twisting alternate take on the iconic PAC-MAN. As The Swordsman, you wake on a mysterious planet amidst relics of wars past. To survive you will discover secrets, consume your enemies, and grow from prey to apex predator.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Forges of Corruption Expansion
item.description: Did you have a hell of a blast purging heretics? Grab your holy chainsword, trusted bolter, and prepare for a brand new chapter of adrenaline-pumping shootout! Bring Boltgun’s bloodfest to another level with its new DLC: Forges of Corruption.

item.title: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden
item.description: Hunt ghosts as two memorable characters in a story-driven Action-RPG where your decisions carry dramatic consequences. Torn between honoring your oath to the living and saving your departed partner, how far will you go for love?

item.title: Battlefleet Gothic: Armada 2
item.description: Battlefleet Gothic: Armada 2 is the new real-time strategy game adapted from Games Workshop’s famous tabletop game that portrays the epic space battles of the Warhammer 40,000 universe.

item.title: Call of Cthulhu®
item.description: 1924. Private Investigator Pierce is sent to look into the tragic death of the Hawkins family. Plunge into a world of creeping madness and cosmic horror. Cryptic clues, shadowy figures, and pure terror bar your way as you fight to retain your sanity and solve an otherworldly mystery.

item.title: Call of the Wild: The Angler™
item.description: The Angler is an open world fishing game that can be played solo or with friends. Discover and catch a wide variety of unique fish species, from common to rare, on your journey to become a master angler.

item.title: Chants of Sennaar
item.description: In this award-winning puzzle adventure game, play as the Traveler on a quest to reunite the Peoples of the Tower. Observe, listen, and decipher ancient languages in a fascinating universe inspired by the Myth of Babel.

item.title: Evil West
item.description: A dark menace consumes the Old West. In solo or coop, fight with style in visceral, explosive combat against bloodthirsty monstrosities. Eradicate the vampiric hordes with your lightning-fueled gauntlet and become a Wild West Superhero.

item.title: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game
item.description: Embark on scientific expeditions with this new off-road adventure game. Lead research missions as you drive a variety of all-terrain vehicles, using high-tech tools and managing your camp and crew to ensure your success in the wild.

item.title: Farmer's Dynasty 2
item.description: Build your dream farm and secure your family’s future. Cultivate your fields, raise animals, and shape your dynasty across generations in this beautifully crafted life and farming simulation. Start your dynasty today!

item.title: Generation Zero®
item.description: Generation Zero is a stealth-action shooter where you wage guerilla warfare against lethal mechanical enemies. Explore a vast open world map inspired by the Swedish Cold War era, take part in the resistance alone or with up to three friends in seamless co-op.

item.title: GreedFall
item.description: Engage in a core roleplaying experience, and forge the destiny of a new world seeping with magic, and filled with riches, lost secrets, and fantastic creatures. With diplomacy, deception and force, become part of a living, evolving world - influence its course and shape your story.

item.title: Insurgency: Sandstorm
item.description: Insurgency: Sandstorm is a hardcore tactical FPS built on lethal close-quarters combat and ruthless intensity. Every bullet count, every step matters, and teamwork is your only path to survival in the brutality of modern warfare.

item.title: Journey
item.description: Explore the ancient, mysterious world of Journey as you soar above ruins and glide across sands to discover its secrets.

item.title: Maktala: Slime Lootfest
item.description: An incremental game where you kill hordes of slimes and use their loot to become stronger and farm them. Collect powerful loot, master skills, and uncover tons of content.

item.title: MIO: Memories in Orbit
item.description: Play as android MIO in this mesmerizing metroidvania where you explore the Vessel, an enormous technological ark overgrown with machines gone rogue. Uncover its secrets, enhance MIO's abilities, and save the spaceship and its residents from oblivion.

item.title: My Time at Portia
item.description: Start a new life in the enchanting town of Portia! Restore your Pa's neglected workshop to its former glory by fulfilling commissions, growing crops, raising animals, and befriending the quirky inhabitants of this charming post-apocalyptic land!

item.title: Neon White
item.description: Neon White is a single-player speedrunning FPS where you can sacrifice your guns for godlike parkour moves.

item.title: PAC-MAN MUSEUM+
item.description: PAC-MAN MUSEUM+ includes 14 titles from the legendary PAC-MAN series! Play a variety of classic and nostalgic PAC-MAN games across many genres!

item.title: PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC
item.description: PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC modernizes, updates, and enhances the fan favorite 3D Platforming adventure in nearly every way! Venture across PAC-LAND to reclaim the golden fruit and put a stop to the ghosts and their dastardly boss, Spooky!

item.title: PAC-MAN WORLD Re-PAC
item.description: PAC-MAN arrives home on his birthday to find the Ghosts have kidnapped PAC-MAN’s family and ruined his party! Off to the rescue, PAC-MAN sets out to Ghost Island!

item.title: PAC-MAN™ Championship Edition DX+
item.description: It's time to gear up!Get ready for more ghost chain gobbling and frantic action in PAC-MAN® CE-DX+! The award-winning chomping game makes a shattering debut on Steam with even more content and a refined user-interface to compare high scores with your friends!

item.title: RoadCraft
item.description: As the leader of a company specialized in restoring sites devastated by natural disasters, use your construction machinery to restart the local industry. Clear debris and faulty equipment, rebuild roads and bridges damaged by weather, and much more!

item.title: Solar Ash
item.description: From the creators of the award-winning Hyper Light Drifter comes the high-speed and gravity-bending world of Solar Ash.

item.title: Storyteller
item.description: Storyteller is an award-winning puzzle game about building stories. Start with a title, settings and characters and create a story that fits the story’s description. Play with stories of love, intrigue, crime, monsters, betrayal, and more!

item.title: Stray
item.description: Lost, alone and separated from family, a stray cat must untangle an ancient mystery to escape a long-forgotten cybercity and find their way home.

item.title: The Artful Escape
item.description: A teenage guitar prodigy sets out on a psychedelic journey to inspire his stage persona and confront the legacy of a dead folk legend. Starring voice performances by Michael Johnston, Caroline Kinley, Lena Headey, Jason Schwartzman, Mark Strong, and Carl Weathers.

item.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 9
item.description: Save your next party! 5 new games in 1 Party Pack: the trivia bluff-off Fibbage 4, the team test Quixort, the joke auction Junktopia, the silly guessfest Nonsensory and the reality TV game Roomerang.

item.title: Ultimate Admiral: Age of Sail
item.description: Ultimate Admiral: Age of Sail is a tactical wargame from the creators of the Ultimate General series set amidst the epic naval campaigns in the period of the American Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars.

item.title: Ultimate General: Civil War
item.description: Ultimate General: Civil War is a tactical real time strategy war-game. Experience the bloodiest period of U.S. history - the American Civil War of 1861-1865.

item.title: Void Crew
item.description: Void Crew is a Chaotic, Co-op Roguelite game for 1 to 6 players: Outfit your spaceship and crew for thrilling quests, brave fierce enemies in Space Battles... and try not to panic!

item.title: Void War
item.description: Command an ancient starship and fight your way to the heart of a dying Empire. Fend off attacks from demented cultists, craven space pirates, and xenophobic Imperial soldiers. Discover powerful artifacts and use them to build your ship into a fearsome war engine.

item.title: Wanderstop
item.description: From the creator of The Stanley Parable and The Beginner’s Guide comes Wanderstop, a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun
item.description: Load up your Boltgun and unleash the awesome Space Marine arsenal to blast your way through an explosion of sprites, pixels and blood in a perfect blend of Warhammer 40,000, frenetic gameplay and the stylish visuals of 90’s retro shooters.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2
item.description: Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine. Unleash deadly abilities and devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid swarms. Defend the Imperium in spectacular third-person action in solo or multiplayer modes.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks
item.description: High-orktane combat racing in the Warhammer 40,000 universe! Drive buggies, tanks and helicopters, mastering advanced movement and explosive weaponry online or against bots. Unlock gear, customize your rides and use the NEW Creation Workshop to create, share, and play custom maps from the community!

item.title: What Remains of Edith Finch
item.description: What Remains of Edith Finch is a collection of strange tales about a family in Washington state. As Edith, you’ll explore the colossal Finch house, searching for stories as she explores her family history and tries to figure out why she's the last one in her family left alive.

item.title: AquaDream Soundtrack
item.description: The AquaDream Soundtracks pack includes the five original tracks from the game, composed by Joshua Liljeblad, along with their Reverb versions.

item.title: Dino running from a FURRY: GAMESFORFARM
item.description: Run, Dino, run — Mr. Furry is already close! Collect coins, avoid obstacles, unlock new costumes, and set records in a crazy 2.5D runner. Most importantly — do not let yourself get caught… it is better not to know what happens next.
